sources.locator: B124 General Specifications table; B126 Ordering table; B127 WR11 circuit table and solder-lug figure
sources.evidence_extract: NKK WR11AS: maintained SPST ON-OFF; terminals 1a and 1b connect ON, open OFF; terminal 1 absent. Silver contacts rated 15 A at 30 V DC for resistive load. Panel opening 34.2 by 17.2 mm (+0.3/-0), panel thickness 1-4 mm. S suffix: epoxy-sealed solder lugs; A: black rocker. Front panel IP67; behind panel IP60. Operating ambient -25 to +85 C. Contact resistance 10 milliohms maximum for solder lugs. No capacitive-load endurance or minimum applicable load specified here.

sources.locator: COMPONENTS table SW2/J5; EXTERNAL_COMPONENTS table SW2; NETS rows V15_FUSED/V15
sources.evidence_extract: SW2 is WR11AS, externally mounted and hand-wired. 1a=V15_FUSED via J5.1; 1b=V15 via J5.2. F1 upstream; both converters and D10 on V15; GND continuous. SW2 has no LCSC or PCB footprint, is fitted and in the system BOM. J5 is a bare solder-pad pair. Normal design input about 15 V, 0.41 A; this is not a bench measurement.
